$comment: Worked example (issue #7): the Stage-2 per-unit contract for u-tokenize-1. This is the exact shape contract_extract.py writes per unit (one <unit-id>.contract.json under --out); see 'python framework/tools/contract_extract.py extract --help'. The tool EXTRACTS from pytest collection + AST + docstring tags — an LLM may enrich invariants later, but that is an edit, not a check.
invariants: Invariant: empty input raises ValueError (never returns [])
Invariant: tokens are lowercased, NFC-normalized, split on whitespace
Postcondition: duplicates and input order are preserved — dedupe is a separate unit
